meta.title: 《小丑》拉片完整版-中集
meta.title_en: Joker: A Full Scene-by-Scene Breakdown, Part 2

scenes.context: 好的电影导演如何通过画面操控观众的观影情绪？继续用小丑来分析导演的工作。
scenes.speak: Directors steer emotion through images. We keep breaking down Joker.

scenes.context: 电影是综合艺术，摄影音效音乐美术服装化妆缺一不可，而最直接影响观众的是摄影画面和音乐音效。
sentences: Image and sound hit viewers first.
paraphrase: Image and sound hit viewers first.
scenes.speak: Film is a synthetic art. Image and sound hit viewers first.

scenes.context: 音效不只是给画面配音，把听和视并列是因为听不只是视的附属，音效可以独立制造情绪。
paraphrase: 用sight and sound换一种说法
scenes.speak: Sound is more than dubbing. Sound sits beside image.

scenes.context: 导演把下一场戏踹垃圾箱的音效提前到老板训话的画面里，让观众感到亚瑟心里的怒火已经烧起来。
sentences: Play the next scene's sound early.
The sound previews the rage inside.
paraphrase: Play the next scene's sound early.
The sound previews the rage inside.
scenes.speak: Play the next scene's sound early. The sound previews the rage inside.

scenes.context: 镜头朝亚瑟缓缓推进，老板声音压低，一个心跳音效渐渐引入，随镜头越推越响。
scenes.speak: The camera pushes in slowly. A heartbeat sound fades in.

scenes.context: 这场戏大多遵守轴线规则，但最后一个镜头摄影机忽然越到轴线对面，用故意越轴制造人物立场。
sentences: Crossing it on purpose builds tension.
paraphrase: 用cross the axis换一种说法
Crossing it on purpose builds tension.
scenes.speak: Most shots respect the axis. Crossing it on purpose builds tension.

scenes.context: 同一场景镜头不停切换，观众需要轴线来记住人物的相对位置，不越轴才不会产生混乱。
sentences: The axis helps viewers track positions.
Staying on-axis keeps the space clear.
paraphrase: The axis helps viewers track positions.
Staying on-axis keeps the space clear.
scenes.speak: The axis helps viewers track positions. Staying on-axis keeps the space clear.

scenes.title_en: The Power of the Emotional Climb
scenes.context: 从隐忍到不耐烦再到怒火，情绪递进通过画面和声音被精准传递，这就是视听语言的魅力。
sentences: Sight and sound carry the mood.
paraphrase: Sight and sound carry the mood.
scenes.speak: Emotion climbs step by step. Sight and sound carry the mood.
